# Jabbit - Peptide Tracking App
> Jabbit is an iPhone app for people who take GLP-1 medications or other injectable peptides. It logs doses and injection sites, tracks vials and reconstitution, estimates medication levels, and records progress. No account; data syncs through the user's own iCloud. Made by Bridger Apps, LLC.

## Key Features
- Smart injection tracking with 14-zone site rotation
- Vial management with reconstitution calculator
- Real-time serum level visualization (pharmacokinetic curves)
- Flexible dosing schedules (daily, EOD, 2x/week, 5-on-2-off, custom)
- Titration and cycle planning
- Progress tracking with Apple Health sync
- In-app encyclopedia of peptides with half-life data
- Privacy-first: iCloud sync only, no server storage

## Pricing (US App Store, as of October 2026)
- Free download with a 14-day free trial
- Then $9.99/year (the App Store lists one in-app purchase, "Jabbit Pro", at $9.99)
- iPhone app (iOS 17 or later; the listing says it also runs on iPad); no Android app

## Study Teardowns
Critical single-study reads: design, comparator, funding, dropout, effect size, enrollment, and durability, with charts rebuilt from published numbers.
- Study teardowns hub: https://jabbitapp.com/research
- Does microdosing Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound or Mounjaro work? (Oct 20, 2026; pegged to the Cedars-Sinai 'low-dose' semaglutide HFpEF study, Eur Heart J Oct 5, 2026: preprint rat dose 30 nmol/kg twice weekly scales to ~2.4 mg/week by FDA's body-surface conversion, the full Wegovy dose; lowest randomized doses: daily semaglutide 0.05 mg -6.0% vs -2.3% placebo at 52 weeks, tirzepatide 1 mg -0.9 kg vs -0.4 kg at 26 weeks; SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN step-down to 5 mg -16.6% vs -21.9% full dose vs -9.9% placebo at week 112; Jabbit label scan: 4 of 9 US GLP-1 labels call the starter dose ineffective/titration-only/not for maintenance, 4 pen instructions say don't count clicks; Jabbit ClinicalTrials.gov review: 15 studies deliberately test lower-than-usual GLP-1 doses, 0 with posted results; PubMed: 0 randomized microdosing trials): https://jabbitapp.com/research/microdosing-ozempic-wegovy-zepbound-mounjaro-low-dose.html
- Do Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound or Mounjaro weaken your bones? (World Osteoporosis Day, Oct 20, 2026; semaglutide 1.0 mg vs placebo, 52 weeks: total hip aBMD -0.020 g/cm2, CTX up, P1NP unchanged; S-LiTE: liraglutide plus exercise kept hip/spine BMD at placebo level; TABFAT tirzepatide poster: total hip -3.2% in 6 months; ADA 2026 abstract: tirzepatide trials 37/6,357 vs 13/3,883 fractures, OR 1.84; Wegovy label: hip/pelvis fractures 1% vs 0.2% in women, 2.4% vs 0.6% age 75+; Jabbit label scan: 1 of 9 US GLP-1 labels mentions fractures, 0 mention BMD; Jabbit ClinicalTrials.gov review: 30 bone studies, 2 with results, 0 tirzepatide vs placebo, 0 of 86 retatrutide/orforglipron studies): https://jabbitapp.com/research/ozempic-wegovy-zepbound-bone-loss-osteoporosis-fracture.html
- Should Australia's peptide ER numbers worry anyone using gray-market retatrutide? (NSW Health report released Oct 19, 2026: 1,180 emergency visits mentioning unapproved peptides, July 2025-September 2026, 5 a month to 217; 833 mention retatrutide (735 retatrutide only, 347 other peptides only, 98 both); 18% admitted; Jabbit read of the report's Figure 1 chart data: admissions 24-30 a month from May while visits rose 125 to 217, admitted share 19%/20%/16%; 57% under 35 vs 9.3% of NSW GLP-1 users in the 2025 survey, 4% vs 51% aged 55+; lab findings: TGA product sold as retatrutide held semaglutide at ~8x approved levels and no retatrutide, Piatkowski 2026 vials labelled 10 mg held 5.1/16.5/19.0 mg, 7 Victorian acute liver injuries with a suspected contaminant, MHRA seized 12,000+ fake pens Oct 14; U.S.: America's Poison Centers 249/460/862 retatrutide exposures per quarter in 2026 (CBS), Jabbit openFDA FAERS pull 44 retatrutide reports through June 30, 2026 (33 serious, 0 deaths in public data), BPC-157 18; TRIUMPH-1 nausea 42.4% vs 14.8% at 12 mg): https://jabbitapp.com/research/retatrutide-peptides-emergency-department-nsw-health.html
- Does DMSO work for ALS, pain or cancer, and is it safe to try? (Viral X stories Oct 17, 2026; Jabbit ClinicalTrials.gov review: 183 studies mention DMSO, 8 test it alone as a treatment (6 bladder), 0 for ALS, 0 with posted results; Jabbit PubMed review: 169 records tagged RCT, 35 test DMSO itself in people (bladder 7, pain 9, skin 5, 14 from one Baghdad surgeon), 0 in ALS; Pennsaid FDA label: 45.5% DMSO vehicle and 2.3% DMSO placebo both -4.7 WOMAC pain; Burke 2022 vitamin C in DMSO vs imiquimod 13/15 vs 8/14 basal cell lesions; RIMSO-50 NDA 017788 approved 1978 for interstitial cystitis only, not for IV use, first generic ANDA 220173 July 2026; 9 OTC 'DMSO' creams on DailyMed list no DMSO as an active ingredient; 1980 House hearing and FDA testimony; IV hemolysis reports; FDA advisory letters 2021 and 2026): https://jabbitapp.com/research/dmso-dimethyl-sulfoxide-als-pain-cancer-teardown.html
- Why is Lilly suing FDA to call retatrutide a biologic, and what does it change for generics and compounding? (FDA remand decision Oct 2, 2026: 39 alpha amino acids, not a protein or analogous product, file under section 505; 7th Cir. No. 26-1301 jurisdiction briefs Oct 8; biologic = 12-year bar on copies vs 4-5 years for generic filings; compounding exemptions exclude biologics; Medicare prices at 9 vs 13 years; compound patent US 11,542,313 to about Jan 20, 2039; Jabbit table of 14 molecules around the 40-amino-acid line; CagriSema filed as an NDA): https://jabbitapp.com/research/retatrutide-biologic-lilly-fda-lawsuit-generics-compounding.html
- Should you take generic oral minoxidil now instead of waiting for Veradermics' VDPHL01 pill? (Study 304 topline Oct 19, 2026: 536 men, +28.6/+36.4 vs +6.6 hairs/cm² at 6 months, hypertrichosis 2.2%/9.0%, trial excluded uncontrolled blood pressure, certain heart conditions and recent beta blockers; 505(b)(2), method-of-use patents to 2043, no filing date; Jabbit DailyMed scan: all 32 generic minoxidil tablet labels carry the pericardial effusion boxed warning and say hair growth is not approved, strengths only 2.5 and 10 mg; Jabbit ClinicalTrials.gov review: 16 oral/sublingual minoxidil hair-loss studies, 0 with results, VDPHL01 registrations never say minoxidil; low-dose safety data: 1,404-patient series, TriNetX 9,724-patient cohort, FAERS signals; finasteride comparison): https://jabbitapp.com/research/oral-minoxidil-vdphl01-veradermics-hair-loss-pill.html
- How much muscle do you lose on Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound or Mounjaro, and what preserves it? (DXA lean mass 28.9-34% of weight lost in the GLP-1 control arms of BELIEVE, EMBRAZE, COURAGE and QUALITY, vs about 8-18% with experimental muscle drugs; MRI thigh muscle loss roughly proportional to weight lost (SURPASS-3); guidelines: strength training plus protein 1.2-1.6 g/kg proposed during weight loss; creatine meta-analysis +1.37 kg lean with resistance training in older adults; Jabbit ClinicalTrials.gov review: 70 registered muscle studies, 3 with posted results, 1 creatine trial due May 2027): https://jabbitapp.com/research/muscle-loss-ozempic-wegovy-zepbound-lean-mass-creatine.html
- Is testosterone therapy (TRT) a wonder drug for men over 40? (TRAVERSE NEJM 2023, 5,246 men, MACE 7.0% vs 7.3%, atrial fibrillation 3.5% vs 2.4%, fractures 3.50% vs 2.46% HR 1.43; T Trials NEJM 2016: sexual function improved, vitality and walking did not; FDA June 18, 2026 label request; Jabbit DailyMed scan: 14 of 15 testosterone labels published since still carry the age-related limitation): https://jabbitapp.com/research/testosterone-trt-men-over-40-traverse-evidence.html
